claims.statement: A stored plan-conformance status is revalidated against the exact qualification plan content and exact receipt before interpretation may rely on it.
Qualified interpretation cannot claim an evidence tier above either the precommitted claim target or the plan evidence target.
A valid terminal failure remains valid negative execution evidence and can support NotSatisfied without becoming invalid evidence.

Interpretation binds the exact subject, qualification-plan digest, receipt digests, conformance digests, and responsible interpreter provenance; model assistance cannot replace or widen that authority.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile the inherited HAK-007 evidence linter.
Lint the HAK-008 machine-readable qualification plan with HAK-007 tooling.
Validate HAK-008 JSON Schema syntax and validate representative conformance/interpretation documents against the schemas.
Run the focused HAK-008 interpretation and schema regression suites.

required_negative_cases: Satisfied conformance missing a required check
Satisfied conformance backed by non-success receipt
Qualified interpretation above claim target tier
model assistance attempting to exceed evidence ceiling
schema accepts stale ModelAssistedReview authority kind
schema accepts missing plan digest binding

independence.claim_interpretation: separate bounded interpretation of hosted result remains required
